subject.declared_domain: Two GENERATED JSON spec files -- each written by a named generator script, NOT hand-authored -- that ingest_c2c3_motif_producer folds ADDITIVELY into graph_nodes/graph_edges: motif_c2c3_materialize.json (the 07-08 debt/deviation layer) and motif_c2c3_materialize_ab.json (the 07-18 A+B canonical layer). methodology.how: Two JSON documents, each carrying producer/consumer/grounding metadata plus a nodes array and an edges array. ⛔ THEY ARE GENERATED, NOT HAND-AUTHORED, AND MY FIRST CARD SAID THE OPPOSITE: each is written by a NAMED SCRIPT that opens it for writing and json.dumps into it -- NFRA_MOTIF_P1_canonical_ab_catalog.py:58/:464-465 produces motif_c2c3_materialize_ab.json (the CANONICAL 13 C2Motif + 3 C3System), and MOTIF_c2c3_materialize_spec.py:44/:160 produces motif_c2c3_materialize.json (the DEVIATION subset, 6 C2Motif + 1 C3System). The two tiers have a generator EACH, and the canonical/deviation split the rule bank protects runs along that same line. derive_runner folds them additively in a fixed order at ingest_c2c3_motif_producer, on the stated ground that their node_ids are disjoint by construction so the union is clean. THE BURIED OPINIONS, IN PROSE because the TO's form is prose: (1) THE SPEC FILES ARE DELIBERATELY RETAINED against a dispatch that read literally would delete them -- derive_runner:1363-1367 records that removing them breaks the acceptance harness, whose FROZEN_CONTROL is the hardcoded {'C2Motif': 19, 'C3System': 4}; (2) THAT FROZEN CONTROL IS ITSELF AN OPINION -- an acceptance test whose expected value is the static layers' own contents will pass for as long as the static layers are folded, whatever the live composition does; (3) the two layers use DIFFERENT NAMING CONVENTIONS, measurable in their outputs; (4) additive-fold order is fixed and undeclared as significant.
declared_opinions: THE SPEC FILES ARE DELIBERATELY RETAINED against a dispatch that read literally would delete them -- derive_runner:1363-1367 records that removing them breaks the acceptance harness. The retention is reasoned and written down, which is better than most, but it is still a judgement encoded in a comment.

FROZEN_CONTROL = {'C2Motif': 19, 'C3System': 4} at c2c3_liveness_acceptance.py:48 is itself an opinion: an acceptance expectation whose value is the static layers' own contents, so it passes for as long as they are folded regardless of what the live composition does.

The two layers use DIFFERENT NAMING CONVENTIONS -- three C3System nodes carry name == theme while system:firm-conditional-display:25558d98 carries name 'EmergentSystem', a measurable artefact of two authoring events ten days apart.
The additive-fold ORDER is fixed in C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_PATHS and its significance is undeclared; the disjoint-id argument makes order immaterial only for as long as the ids stay disjoint.

The 4 C3System node_ids in the spec files are system:firm-conditional-display:25558d98, system:object-data:ff0f4d26, system:compute-orchestration:7628b54d and system:pipeline:d944eb81 -- BYTE-IDENTICAL AS A SET to the 4 measured live in wave 1, with zero in either direction. ⛔ SO THE LIVE C3System TIER IS THE STATIC FOLD IN ITS ENTIRETY, AND THE LIVE COMPOSITION CONTRIBUTES ZERO C3System NODES. key.identity_space: the same 'system:<theme>:<sha1[:8] over the sorted member-motif nid set>' space the live cover mints, plus C2Motif nids carried in the spec files
key.key_expression: key(n) = n['node_id'] -- read verbatim from the node object in motif_c2c3_materialize.json / motif_c2c3_materialize_ab.json. THE KEY IS CARRIED, NOT RECOMPUTED AT READ TIME: C3System members read 'system:<theme>:<sha1[:8]>' and C2Motif members read 'motif:<name>'. The sha1[:8] is how the PRODUCER minted the id; a consumer never re-derives it, so the mint is not part of this expression.
key.evidence: MEASURED. The spec files carry ids in the SAME minted space this lane exercised in wave 1 over 5 arms, where adding or removing a single member motif mints a new node_id -- so key_is_stable='unstable' in this schema's sense ('the key is derived from something mutable') is inherited, and the inheritance is now measured rather than assumed because the id set matched live exactly. ⛔ A CONSEQUENCE SPECIFIC TO A STATIC FILE, AND IT IS SHARPER THAN THE LIVE CASE: these ids are FROZEN IN A HAND-AUTHORED FILE. If the underlying member set ever changed, the file would keep asserting the old id, and the fold would materialize a node whose id no longer describes its own membership -- with nothing to detect it, because the spec is the source and there is nothing to compare it against. crosses_spaces=false: the nids stay within the graph's own node_id space. declared_mapping=null after a hunt across both spec files' metadata blocks (producer, consumer, cert, grounding, convention_note, taxonomy_prereq, c3_model), the fold code, and the live node properties. || v3 delta pass: key_expression ABSENT on this card (not yet declared by the carding lane); row basis lowered from measured to the floor. || DISCHARGED by exercise in the KEYFILL-COX fill: exercised on a real member -- C3System node in motif_c2c3_materialize_ab.json -> system:object-data:ff0f4d26 in graph node id ('system:<theme>:<sha1[:8]>' | 'motif:<name>'). failure_mode.returns_on_failure: EXERCISED at the fold layer: a spec path that cannot be opened is caught and reported as 'WARN: C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_ABSENT path=<path> err=<e> -- skipping this spec (derive UNAFFECTED)', the spec is skipped, and the derive continues. The failure is LOUD and names both the path and the underlying error.
silent_degrade_paths: ⛔ ONCE FOLDED, A STATIC-SPEC NODE IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A LIVE-COMPOSED ONE. The fold is additive into the same graph_nodes table with the same node_type and no provenance marker -- which is why my wave-1 card could only say the C3System tier was 'consistent with' being static, and why settling it needed a separate id-set comparison. A consumer reading the graph cannot tell which half it is standing on.

THE ACCEPTANCE HARNESS CANNOT FAIL ON THIS. FROZEN_CONTROL = {'C2Motif': 19, 'C3System': 4} is satisfied by the static fold ALONE, so it passes whether or not the live composition contributed anything -- and the live composition contributes zero C3System, measured. The control is green in exactly the state it exists to detect.

⛔ THE WARN SAYS 'ABSENT' FOR CAUSES THAT ARE NOT ABSENCE, MEASURED AT SOURCE: the guard is a broad `except Exception`, so a spec file that is PRESENT BUT CORRUPT -- malformed JSON, a permissions error, a truncated write -- is reported with the same C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_ABSENT label and skipped identically. An operator reading that WARN would go looking for a missing file. The err= field carries the real cause, so it is recoverable by a careful reader, but the LABEL is wrong for every non-absence case.
A spec file whose member sets have gone stale keeps asserting frozen ids; nothing recomputes the membership hash to compare against the id the file declares.
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED per COX2-AC7. (1) THE GUARD READ VERBATIM at the fold loop in derive_runner (`for spec_path in C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_PATHS`): try/open/json.load wrapped in `except Exception as e` emitting 'WARN: C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_ABSENT path=... err=... -- skipping this spec (derive UNAFFECTED)'. (2) THE TRIGGERING CONDITION EXERCISED: os.path.exists on a nonexistent spec path -> False, with a CONTROL on the real spec path -> True in the same run, so the check can return either; an unguarded open of the missing path raises FileNotFoundError errno=2, which is the exception class that guard catches. (3) ⛔ THE FINDING THE EXERCISE PRODUCED, which a docstring read would not have: the guard is `except Exception`, NOT `except FileNotFoundError`, so the 'ABSENT' label is applied to every failure mode including a present-but-corrupt file. distinguishable='no' therefore stands and is now measured on TWO grounds rather than one -- static-vs-live indistinguishability after the fold, and absent-vs-corrupt indistinguishability in the WARN label. ⚠ I did NOT remove or corrupt a real spec file to observe the WARN print: the files are live inputs to the nightly derive and this TO is qualify-only. What I exercised is the condition and the exception class; the emission itself is read at source and that limit is stated rather than absorbed.

verdict.why: A measured defect blocks load-bearing use. (1) THE ACCEPTANCE CONTROL CANNOT FAIL ON THE THING IT CHECKS: FROZEN_CONTROL = {'C2Motif': 19, 'C3System': 4} is satisfied by the static fold alone, and the live composition contributes ZERO C3System nodes -- so a harness intended to show the instance layer is live passes on static content whether or not it is. That is a control that is green in exactly the state it exists to detect. (2) ONCE FOLDED, STATIC AND LIVE NODES ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE -- same table, same node_type, no provenance marker -- so a consumer cannot tell which half it is standing on, and establishing it required a hand id-set comparison against a prior wave's measurement. (3) THE IDS ARE FROZEN IN HAND-AUTHORED FILES while the space they are drawn from is membership-derived and unstable, so a file can assert an id that no longer describes its own membership with nothing able to detect it. (4) The runtime copy is a build-time COPY of the repo copy and nothing compares them. ⛔ NOT SOFTENED, AND NOT A DEPRECATION VERDICT: these files are careful, well-documented work, their retention is a REASONED decision recorded in the derive with its rationale, and the disjoint-id argument for the additive fold is sound. Whether they should exist is not this card's question and I express no view on it -- W2-m-3 puts that in a second pass and the sequencing is load-bearing. What is measured is that the estate cannot currently tell their output apart from live output, and that its acceptance control cannot either. || SEMANTIC-AXIS DECLARATION: NOT SYSTEMATICALLY EXAMINED. The four opinions in methodology.how surfaced from reading the fold and the retention comment. I did NOT audit whether the 19 motifs still describe real estate structure, whether the two layers' definitions of 'motif' agree with each other, or whether the 07-08 layer's differing naming convention reflects a superseded model. ⛔ Counting nodes in a JSON file tells me the file's SHAPE and nothing about whether its content is still true. || GENERATOR CURRENCY: materializer_standing='historical_in_use', and here it is MEASURED rather than inferred -- the files carry their authoring dates, they are still folded by the live derive, and derive_runner records the explicit decision to retain them. || AMENDMENT SCOPE NOTE: the issuer's authorization (74182) enumerated methodology.how and location.projection_of. Applying it I found the SAME false claim in TWO fields nobody had enumerated -- subject.declared_domain ('Two hand-authored JSON spec files') and verdict.blocking_defects[2] ('frozen in hand-authored files'). I corrected those too and declared it rather than either leaving a card that still asserts the falsehood in two places while claiming to be corrected, or widening silently. ⛔ THE ENUMERATION WAS OF WHERE THE CLAIM WAS KNOWN TO LIVE, NOT OF WHERE IT LIVED -- the same shape as this wave's own recurring class, met inside the fix for it. The single surviving 'hand-authored' string in this card is now the QUOTATION of the false claim inside methodology.evidence, which is deliberate and must not be edited away.
